In this channel there are videos with Dr. Stephen R. Gunter, D.C. who has been key to our day to day health and fitness plan. There are videos on chiropractic, sports medicine, kinethesiology. Without the optimal health we get, it would be impossible to upload videos that evolve around art, painting, music, travel, health and nature in the Monterey, Carmel, and Big Sur coastline. 

We hope you enjoy our content featured here in You Tube. Thank you for watching, liking, commenting, subscribing and sharing. Your voice is inspiring and helps us improve the quality of our videos. You are a great indicator to provide more quality movies, particularly in health and overall well-being.
